item_data.name: Chorizo Verde
item_data.description:
Green Chorizo, a relatively new sausage variety hailing from Toluca, Mexico. This stands out from its cousin, red chorizo, by being loaded with fresh chiles and herbs picked fresh from our garden, then roasted over flames. Herbaceous, a little spicy, and bursting with flavor!

Use just as you would any other style of Mexican chorizo. With eggs, tacos, salad, soups, or with rice or potatoes.
